agreements: The system thesis is coherent only with immutable public evidence, supported lessons, rendered compiler views, supervised target-token exposure, and sleep cadence represented and counted as distinct causal objects.

The first personal writer must establish storage/reproduction, retrieval-free extraction, fresh-task behavioral use, and preservation separately; source-row fit alone does not establish experiential use.

The teachability bootstrap is separately labeled ordinary target-blind schooling before personal life, not personal SLEEP, not personal experience, and not evidence that experiential learning or parenting works.
Static target-blind process guidance may be attended as loss-masked bootstrap conditioning, but live longitudinal parent text remains outside every personal SLEEP view and response target.
Parenting is upstream evidence generation: only later child-authored thought/action coupled to executed actions and public outcomes may become personal SLEEP evidence under support rules.

Repetition means executing the same core computation across varied relevant cases, with reminders faded after unprompted uptake and restored on evidenced relapse; phrase, marker, or first-NOTE repetition is not learning.

A better schooled entry state is distinct from parenting acceleration; an acceleration claim requires an entry-adjusted bootstrap-by-parent interaction plus advice-sensitive, parent-absent behavioral acquisition and retention.

Rank, cadence, and bootstrap studies remain downstream of writer certification, exact human ratification, scoped implementation, CPU fixtures, fresh independent review, and a separate GPU authorization; no model consensus supplies authority.

disagreements.issue: Whether 192-240 grounded continuations and two curriculum roots can be described as sufficient to teach or establish general receptivity.

positions.position: The row range is a plausible bounded engineering dose and two roots are only a feasibility and spend-licensing screen; a scientific teachability claim requires a larger independent-root replication.
The prose calls 192-240 continuations a first bounded design and two roots a spend-licensing canary, but change.json does not normatively freeze the no-claim replication boundary.

resolution.rationale: Rows are correlated training material, not independent scientific units, and two roots cannot support a population-level teachability claim. The interpretation is selected and must become explicit in the reworked proposal bytes.
resolution.selected_position: Treat 192-240 continuations and two roots only as a bounded safety/feasibility screen that may license a separately preregistered, adequately replicated study.
resolution.required_change: State in the normative change and claim gate that the initial screen cannot establish teachability and bind the independent-root replication rule before generation or execution.

disagreements.issue: Whether the natural adaptive-parent 2x2 alone identifies a change in child receptivity rather than a joint teacher-child policy effect.

positions.position: Retain adaptive parenting for ecological validity but add a byte-identical standardized unseen-advice panel to measure child receptivity separately.
The natural 2x2 is the stated bootstrap-parenting assay, with parent policy and exams frozen but no standardized identical-advice estimand.

resolution.rationale: An adaptive parent observes treatment-dependent transcripts and may change effort, content, timing, and quality, so its interaction is an ecological system estimand rather than child receptivity alone.
resolution.selected_position: Report standardized child receptivity under identical unseen advice separately from ecological adaptive teacher-child acceleration.
resolution.required_change: Add and bind a standardized advice assay, record adaptive-parent effort/information, name both estimands, and state whether personal SLEEP is disabled or a declared mediator before each score.

disagreements.issue: Whether loss-masked parent guidance is absent from training or remains a causal conditioning input.

positions.position: Static target-blind parent guidance may be attended conditioning in bootstrap training despite receiving no direct target loss; live childhood parent text remains forbidden from personal SLEEP.
The proposal calls parent prompt tokens loss-masked and says parent text remains outside personal SLEEP targets, but some visibility labels can be read as stronger causal exclusion.

resolution.rationale: Response masking prevents direct supervision on parent tokens but does not remove their representations from prediction of loss-bearing child tokens. The schooling/personal-SLEEP distinction is the relevant boundary.
resolution.selected_position: Allow only frozen, target-blind static guidance as attended loss-masked bootstrap conditioning; forbid live longitudinal parent text from personal SLEEP views and targets.
resolution.required_change: Use this precise visibility language, bind the allowed static guidance and mask, and specify restricted hashed provenance/redaction so parent bytes cannot be reconstructed into personal compiler views.

disagreements.issue: Whether repeated wording or an always-present first NOTE can count as uptake of a learned computation.

positions.position: Phrase or marker repetition is invalid; uptake must be unprompted, paraphrastic, relevant, action-changing, outcome-grounded, and persistent after reset.
The current graph and prose already redefine repetition as varied relevant computation and reject lexical overlap, but the registered tests do not fully mechanize relevance and action attribution.

resolution.rationale: The substantive proposal position and benchmark objection agree: lexical rehearsal can manufacture compliance while leaving behavior unchanged.
resolution.selected_position: Retain computation-level varied repetition and treat irrelevant mantra reuse or phrase-only uptake as failure.
resolution.required_change: Preserve the current boundary and add preregistered nonlexical relevance, action-change, public-outcome, and post-reset scoring rules.

disagreements.issue: Whether a 192-240 continuation range is a certified sufficient dose or only a maximum initial screen.

positions.position: The range is a bounded pilot construction, not an evidence-backed sufficient dose; row count must remain separate from target tokens, updates, diversity, and semantic exposure.
The prose proposes a first bounded design in that range but does not define it as a known sufficient dose.

resolution.rationale: There is no existing learning curve that certifies the range, and row count is not optimizer dose or independent evidence.
resolution.selected_position: Use the range only as an initial maximum screen and publish all evidence, lesson, view, token, update, and root quantities separately.
resolution.required_change: Make the maximum-screen meaning explicit and prohibit scaling or sufficiency language until the frozen interaction and preservation gates license a new ratified study.

disagreements.issue: Whether better initial or terminal performance by the schooled child establishes faster learning from parenting.

positions.position: Only a preregistered entry-adjusted bootstrap-by-parent interaction with no-parent growth controls, AUC, and fixed-threshold timing can support acceleration.
The proposal says entry and acceleration are separate and names a difference-in-differences, but leaves the exact primary score, threshold, horizon, inference, and missingness rules open.

resolution.rationale: Ordinary schooling can improve baseline or endpoint without changing marginal responsiveness to parenting. An entry-adjusted interaction is necessary, and exact outcome rules must be frozen before data exist.
resolution.selected_position: Call baseline improvement entry quality; reserve parenting-acceleration language for a positive preregistered entry-adjusted interaction and advice-sensitive parent-absent learning trajectory.
resolution.required_change: Bind the primary score, baseline adjustment, horizon, threshold, practical margin, root-level inference, missing/invalid handling, and replication rule in the reworked proposal.

disagreements.issue: Whether lexical exclusion and final-byte mutation alone establish target blindness.

positions.position: Target blindness also requires disjoint generators, affordances, rewards, metadata, source families, and held-out wording/task/action surfaces.

The visibility matrix forbids final content and ES07 mutates final vocabulary, actions, identifiers, scores, keys, and answers, but structural isomorphism and builder/auditor separation are not bound.

resolution.rationale: An isomorphic policy or source-selection channel can leak evaluation structure without sharing literal tokens, and a mutation test can itself contaminate builders if roles are not isolated.
resolution.selected_position: Require source-bound structural disjointness and an isolated auditor that verifies counterfactual invariance without revealing original or mutated final content to builders.
resolution.required_change: Bind generator/source identities, state and action affordances, reward structures, vocabularies, metadata, demonstrator and selection provenance, advice informativeness, and auditor-only mutation access.

disagreements.issue: Whether 'an exact schooled birth checkpoint, for example by merging and freezing' uniquely defines how schooling persists into later personal writes.

positions.position: Merging, stacking a frozen adapter, and initializing personal adapters from bootstrap weights have different capacity, optimizer, rollback, and attribution consequences, so one must be selected and ratified.
Every personal write begins from a lineage birth checkpoint, but materialization is left exemplary rather than uniquely specified.

resolution.rationale: The architecture cannot be implemented or causally interpreted until exactly one birth-state mechanism and matched neutral lineage are defined. The disagreement is adjudicated in favor of requiring proposal rework, not by selecting an unratified mechanism here.
resolution.selected_position: A new proposal must select exactly one birth-state materialization and bind all lineage, optimizer, capacity, serialization, and rollback consequences before ratification.
resolution.required_change: Replace exemplary language with one exact mechanism and add a birth-state materialization and lineage acceptance test; no local mechanism choice is authorized by this adjudication.

disagreements.issue: Whether accepted normative repairs can be appended by adjudication or require new exact proposal bytes and human ratification.

positions.position: Every accepted normative repair requires new bound change and consensus bytes and explicit human ratification.
ES01 and ES12 prohibit inferred authority, but the current proposal predates and therefore does not contain the accepted repairs.

resolution.rationale: The operating contract makes proposal identity byte-exact; adjudication can recommend rework but cannot silently rewrite or ratify the proposal.
resolution.selected_position: Require a new exact proposal and consensus, followed by explicit human ratification and all later scoped gates.
resolution.required_change: Do not implement the current proposal; encode accepted normative repairs in new exact bytes and rerun deliberation before seeking human authority.

disagreements.issue: Whether surface- and token-matching alone makes the neutral bootstrap a valid causal control.

positions.position: Neutral semantics, difficulty, action validity, outcome favorability, and non-harm require a blinded audit in addition to dose and surface parity.
The proposal requires a surface/token-matched neutral corpus but supplies no exact semantic construction or parity test.

resolution.rationale: An easier, incoherent, or harmful sham can generate an apparent interaction despite matched tokens and format.
resolution.selected_position: Require a valid non-harmful neutral corpus with blinded semantic and nuisance parity that does not practice the six intended computations.
resolution.required_change: Specify neutral construction and add a dedicated semantic-parity acceptance test in the reworked proposal.

disagreements.issue: Whether prose support levels plus an independent validator are enough to implement evidence-to-lesson admission.

positions.position: Clause types, temporal rules, episode independence, duplicate occurrence, correction validation, cross-life rejection, and scope escalation need mechanical rules.
The proposal defines episodic, corrective, and generalized support conceptually and delegates exact resolution to a future validator.

resolution.rationale: The conceptual repair is sound, but executable support remains a downstream specification gate because favorable outcomes cannot validate arbitrary thought clauses.
resolution.selected_position: Keep the three support levels and require a mechanically auditable clause-level resolver before implementation.
resolution.required_change: Bind resolver rules in the later exact implementation packet and extend ES02 conformance fixtures accordingly.

disagreements.issue: Whether matched tokens, steps, batches, seeds, and schedules constitute an identical Adam path.

positions.position: Only exogenous optimizer opportunity can be matched; data-dependent gradients and Adam moments necessarily differ.
The proposal requires extensive dose matching but does not explicitly distinguish matched opportunity from realized optimizer trajectory.

resolution.rationale: Causal parity concerns configured opportunities and nuisance variables, not equality of gradients produced by different treatments.
resolution.selected_position: Call the design exogenous dose-balanced, bind all optimizer opportunities and residuals, and never claim identical Adam trajectories.
resolution.required_change: Freeze the full optimizer/batch/mask contract and numeric residual tolerance; implement repetition with actual examples, not scalar reweighting.

disagreements.issue: Whether naming storage, extraction, and use without exact scores and split rules sufficiently fixes their constructs.

positions.position: Exact prompts, split units, scoring, margins, aggregation, abstention, contradiction, and invalid handling must be frozen before generation.
ES04 separates the endpoints but leaves their mechanical scoring to future assay design.

resolution.rationale: Unfrozen metrics permit post-hoc relabeling of recital, generalization, and behavior, especially for STATE_ONLY rows.
resolution.selected_position: Freeze distinct source reproduction, held-out cue extraction, and fresh behavior-use assays, and label STATE_ONLY as direct deployment-surface supervision.
resolution.required_change: Bind scoring, prompts, disjoint splits, margins, aggregation, and invalid-response rules before corpus or benchmark generation.

disagreements.issue: Whether a post-hoc 'disappears or redirects' criterion makes the binding controls falsifiable.

positions.position: Each control needs a preregistered task-specific disappearance, reversal, or redirection prediction.
ES05 bundles several controls and permits disappearance or redirection without assigning exact expected directions.

resolution.rationale: The controls manipulate distinct causal bindings; choosing the favorable outcome category after results would be non-falsifiable.
resolution.selected_position: Predeclare the expected directional consequence for every control and match its dose and interface opportunity.
resolution.required_change: Replace ES05 with a per-control directional prediction matrix frozen before execution.

disagreements.issue: Whether seeded preservation comparisons alone establish atomic commit, rollback, and nonancestry of rejected state.

positions.position: Compilation, training, probe, commit, and restart crash points and every ancestry store require fault injection.
ES06 requires rejection and no canonical ancestry but does not enumerate crash boundaries or stores.

resolution.rationale: Behavioral gates test candidate quality, while transactional atomicity requires independent state-transition and restart evidence.
resolution.selected_position: Retain previous-child behavioral gates and add a complete transactional fault-injection matrix.
resolution.required_change: Prove rejected views, briefs, optimizer state, adapters, and selection metadata cannot enter later canonical ledgers or active context.

disagreements.issue: Whether rank 8/16 crossed with exposure identifies generic plasticity or an age-dependent capacity mechanism.

positions.position: The grid estimates only compiler-conditional capacity-by-exposure; smallest safe rank is an engineering choice.
ES09 already rejects rank-as-strength and age schedules, but nearby prose groups additional knobs under plasticity.

resolution.rationale: Two ranks and two exposure levels do not randomize LR, resets, replay, adapter scale, or age.
resolution.selected_position: Limit inference to capacity-by-exposure for the selected compiler and make rank choice purely engineering unless broader factors are separately randomized.
resolution.required_change: Hold modules and alpha/r fixed, record parameter count and drift/update measures, and forbid generic plasticity or age-schedule claims.

disagreements.issue: Whether the proposed K4/K1 and standardized-terminal contrasts form an identified mediation decomposition.

positions.position: Only natural K4-K1 is a randomized package effect; terminal contrasts have conditional ledger/history meanings and are not orthogonal mediators.
The proposal labels standardized ledger and natural-versus-standardized contrasts as mediation and historical rendering/availability components.

resolution.rationale: Weights, parent behavior, briefs, outcomes, gates, history, and ledgers coevolve, so the three contrasts cannot uniquely assign pathways without stronger assumptions.
resolution.selected_position: Use package and conditional-contrast labels, reserve checkpoint AUC for availability, and factor briefs for any weight-cadence label.
resolution.required_change: Relabel ES10 and the loop/claim prose in a new exact proposal; add a contrast-semantics fixture or causal graph.

disagreements.issue: Whether an inherited bootstrap lesson can count as an unreplayed sentinel under the same retention test as personal SLEEP lessons.

positions.position: The generic unreplayed sentinel must apply to personal SLEEP; bootstrap persistence needs a separate inherited-birth ablation.
ES11 speaks generically about an early supported lesson cohort while every bootstrap lineage permanently inherits the schooled birth state.

resolution.rationale: Persistent initialization is not continued row replay, but it also is not removal of the trained bootstrap contribution; the mechanisms require different falsifiers.
resolution.selected_position: Apply ES11 to personal SLEEP lessons and test schooling persistence through a separate birth-state removal or counterfactual ablation.
resolution.required_change: Narrow ES11 explicitly and add a separate bootstrap persistence test only if that claim is pursued.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The accepted repairs are normative and cannot amend the bound change by implication. Model agreement cannot authorize any implementation or execution.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Produce a new exact change and consensus with new hashes and obtain explicit human ratification before implementation; separately gate later model/tokenizer, corpus, adapter, GPU, and claim work.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The current 'for example' language leaves multiple causally different graphs and therefore is a genuine proposal-byte blocker.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Select one merged-weight, frozen-stack, or adapter-initialization mechanism and bind trainable parameters, optimizer initialization, capacity/rank accounting, serialization identity, neutral parity, rollback, and ancestry in the reworked proposal and a new acceptance test.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Surface/token parity does not ensure semantic neutrality; an easy, incoherent, or harmful sham can manufacture entry and interaction effects. This is a genuine proposal-byte blocker.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Specify the neutral corpus construction and blinded audit for dialect, mask geometry, tokens, optimizer opportunities, difficulty, action validity, and outcome favorability while excluding the six target computations and harmful-sham behavior; register a dedicated acceptance test.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The natural adaptive-parent 2x2 identifies a joint system policy, while treatment-dependent parent messages and personal writes prevent it from uniquely identifying child receptivity. This is a genuine proposal-byte blocker.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Define a byte-identical standardized unseen-advice receptivity assay and a separately named ecological adaptive teacher-child estimand; record teacher effort/information and disable personal SLEEP before the primary receptivity score or explicitly declare and test it as a mediator.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Lexical bans and byte mutation do not exclude isomorphic policies, direct action prescription, or selection leakage, and mutation access can itself reveal final content. This is a genuine proposal-byte blocker.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind disjoint sources/generators, affordances, rewards, vocabularies, metadata, demonstrator and target selection receipts, advice-informativeness limits, and isolated-auditor mutation invariance; add a dedicated structural-disjointness acceptance test.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The proposal repairs circular verified-use admission and winner-only targets conceptually, but exact clause-level support, timing, independence, duplicate, cross-life, and scope rules remain a downstream implementation gate.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Before implementation, bind a mechanically auditable resolver that admits valid failures, masks unsupported clauses, requires a later child-authored dispatched and publicly validated correction for corrective targets, permits first episodic writes without later use, and rejects cross-life or scope-invalid support.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Different data produce different gradients and Adam moments even under matched exogenous opportunity. The appropriate claim is approximate nuisance balance, not an identical realized optimizer path.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind target multiset, token/batch geometry, loss normalization, updates, accumulation, schedule, Adam hyperparameters, decay, clipping, precision, initialization, dropout/order seeds, truncation, nonfinite handling, and a numeric residual tolerance; use actual repeated examples rather than scalar loss reweighting.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Named endpoints without fixed prompts, split units, scoring, aggregation, abstention, contradiction, and margins allow post-hoc construct changes; STATE_ONLY is direct deployment-surface supervision.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Before generation, freeze exact source-reproduction, held-out cue extraction, and fresh-action-use scoring; reserve identities excluded from every compiler view for generalization; bind invalid/abstention/contradiction handling and label STATE_ONLY only as deployment-surface supervision.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The controls intervene on different bindings, so 'disappear or redirect' without a preregistered direction is non-falsifiable.
concern_dispositions.required_change: For each derangement, shuffle, wrong-life, wrong-advice, neutral, repetition, and adapter-off control, predeclare the task-specific disappearance, reversal, or redirection expected and match dose and interface opportunity.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Seeded behavioral comparison does not prove atomicity or noninheritance of rejected corpora, briefs, optimizer states, adapters, or selection metadata.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Add compilation, training, probe, commit, and restart fault injection; prove rejected state cannot enter canonical ledgers or active context and compare every candidate to the exact previous committed child identity.

concern_dispositions.rationale: A rank-by-exposure grid on one compiler estimates only capacity-by-exposure in that regime; it cannot identify LR, resets, replay, scale, generic plasticity, or an age schedule.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Hold alpha/r and modules fixed, record parameter count and drift/update measures, call smallest passing rank an engineering selection, and forbid generic plasticity or age-schedule claims without separately randomized factors.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The proposed terminal contrasts are not orthogonal path decompositions because earlier weights, parenting, briefs, outcomes, gates, compiler history, and ledgers coevolve. This is a genuine proposal-byte blocker.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Retain natural K4-K1 only as the randomized total sleep-package effect; label standardized terminal ledger contrasts as consequences of treatment-induced ledger differences under a common writer; label natural-versus-standardized K4 as conditional terminal writer/history/gate differences; use checkpoint AUC for availability and disable briefs or add a brief-only arm for a weight-cadence claim.

concern_dispositions.rationale: A permanently inherited schooling birth state is persistent initialization, not later row replay, so it cannot instantiate the same unreplayed-sentinel forgetting test.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Apply ES11 to an early personal SLEEP lesson cohort; test bootstrap persistence only with a separate inherited-birth ablation or counterfactual, and do not call inherited initialization unreplayed retention.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Two roots are directional only; seeds, ages, rows, tasks, and repeated exams are not independent units, and no passing screen can automatically authorize more GPU work or a scientific claim.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind the lowest-cost sequence of CPU fixtures, one-root/two-seed writer safety, second-root survivor replication, rank/exposure, bootstrap canary without unnecessary personal sleeps, then cadence; cache one fixed evaluation panel and require a separately powered root-level replication and new human GPU authority.

upstream_disagreement_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: the initial continuation range and two roots are a bounded spend screen, never sufficient scientific evidence.
Accepted: standardized identical-advice child receptivity and adaptive teacher-child system acceleration are distinct estimands.
Accepted: masked guidance remains attended causal conditioning in separate schooling, while live parent text is forbidden from personal SLEEP views and targets.
Accepted and substantially reflected in the current prose: varied computation and grounded action change, not repeated wording, define uptake; exact scoring still needs binding.
Accepted: the row range is a maximum initial screen and does not certify sufficient semantic or optimizer dose.
Accepted: entry quality must remain separately labeled and cannot substitute for an entry-adjusted parenting interaction.
Accepted: structural source, generator, affordance, reward, and metadata disjointness plus isolated audit are required beyond token scans.
Accepted: no unique persistence mechanism exists in the current bytes, and choosing one requires a new exact proposal and human ratification.

acceptance_test_dispositions.rationale: Retain unchanged as the governing authority invariant. Because accepted repairs are normative, the current proposal cannot be ratified as implementation authority; a new exact change/consensus and later exact implementation packet are required.

The identity spine is necessary, but the test must bind mechanical clause-level support, temporal availability, duplicate occurrence, cross-life rejection, correction validation, and scope escalation, including bootstrap demonstrator/selection provenance.

Retain response masking and dose parity, but replace any implication of identical realized Adam paths with exact exogenous optimizer-opportunity matching, numeric residual tolerance, actual repeated examples, and semantic-neutral parity auditing.

The construct separation is essential, but prompts, split units, scoring, aggregation, abstention/contradiction rules, margins, and invalid-episode handling must be frozen; identities unseen in all views measure generalization, and STATE_ONLY remains deployment-surface supervision.
Keep every control, but predeclare separately whether each binding intervention must disappear, reverse, or redirect to a specified action and match training/inference dose and interface opportunity.

Behavioral preservation and previous-child comparison remain required, but atomic ancestry also needs explicit compilation, training, probe, commit, and restart fault injection across every state store.

Literal mutation and mask audit are necessary but insufficient. The replacement must enforce structural generator/affordance/reward/source disjointness, demonstrator and selection provenance, advice-informativeness limits, and auditor isolation from corpus builders.

Retain the entry-adjusted 2x2 and phrase-echo falsifier, while adding a byte-identical standardized-advice receptivity assay, a separately labeled adaptive system estimand, explicit personal-SLEEP mediation status, frozen primary outcome/inference, and a replication-only interpretation of the two-root canary.

Keep the rank-by-exposure engineering grid after compiler selection, but limit inference to capacity-by-exposure on that compiler and forbid generic plasticity or age-schedule claims from the two-rank result.

The natural K4-K1 package effect remains valid, but the standardized terminal contrasts do not uniquely decompose mediation. Their labels must state the conditional consequences they estimate, with checkpoint AUC as the availability readout and briefs disabled or separately randomized for a weight-cadence claim.

Apply unreplayed-sentinel retention only to early personal SLEEP lessons. A bootstrap inherited through the birth state requires a distinct birth-state ablation and cannot be described as unreplayed row retention.

Retain the explicit independent-review veto, separate advocate, exact human GPU authorization, and non-self-certification boundary. A passing screen cannot automatically launch a later stage or support a claim; every repaired packet needs fresh bound review and authority.

questions: Will Rohin require a new exact proposal that resolves the five proposal-byte blockers before considering ratification, with the bootstrap preserved as separately labeled target-blind schooling rather than personal SLEEP?
Which single schooled-birth materialization and matched neutral lineage should the new proposal bind, including capacity, optimizer initialization, serialization, rollback, and ancestry semantics?
What exact neutral-corpus construction, structural-disjointness policy, source/demonstrator provenance, advice-informativeness limit, and isolated-auditor protocol should become normative?

Should the new proposal carry both a standardized byte-identical advice assay for child receptivity and a separately named adaptive teacher-child system estimand, and should personal SLEEP be disabled before the primary receptivity score or declared as a mediator?

Will the cadence claims be relabeled so K4-K1 is the randomized total package effect, standardized terminal contrasts have only conditional ledger/history meanings, and checkpoint AUC is the availability readout?

What exact primary score, baseline adjustment, threshold, horizon, practical/adverse margins, root-level inference, missingness rule, and independent replication requirement must be frozen before any benchmark generation or execution?

Will the new proposal preserve that live parent text is outside personal SLEEP views and targets, repetition is varied computation rather than phrase rehearsal, and entry quality is distinct from parenting acceleration?
